regional_summary_6h.headline: Israeli Airstrikes Spike in Southern Syria; Armenia-Russia Diplomatic Friction Over Journalist
bullets: Israel increased raids in southern Syria, with 267 violations recorded in August, heightening cross-border tension.
Armenia declined to extradite a wanted journalist to Russia, and the individual returned to Tbilisi, complicating regional diplomatic channels.
A statement suggests Russia may withdraw its military base from Armenia without external pressure, signaling potential shifts in the regional security architecture.
regional_summary_6h.watch: Monitor for additional Israeli raids in southern Syria and any changes to Russian military presence in Armenia.
